mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO shows a positive month-over-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increases > 0.2 percentage points over 3 months) signals an imminent economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0% and rising >0.2pp in 3 months), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising month-over-month CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals increasing price pressures, prompting central bank tightening and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL shows a positive month-over-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-industrial production regime (INDPRO > 110), a decline in INDPRO over the last month signals a sudden manufacturing slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 110 and declining >0.5% in 1 month), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
